document.title: Dividends and Distributions
document.issued_by: corporation, mutual fund, RIC, REIT or broker

boxes.label: Total ordinary dividends
boxes.notes: THE REPORTABLE TOTAL for ordinary dividends. Boxes 1b, 2e, 5 and 6 are all breakouts already inside it.

boxes.label: Qualified dividends
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1a with its own destination. 'Shows the portion of the amount in box 1a that may be eligible for reduced capital gains rates.' It goes to Form 1040 line 3a, which is a MEMO line: Form 1040 line 9 adds lines 1z, 2b, 3b, 4b, 5b, 6b, 7a and 8, and does not add 3a. So routing it cannot double-count income.

boxes.label: Total capital gain distr.
boxes.notes: THE REPORTABLE TOTAL for capital gain distributions. Boxes 2b, 2c, 2d and 2f are all breakouts already inside it. The recipient instruction says outright: 'Include all amounts shown in boxes 2b, 2c, 2d, and 2f.' (filer instruction, i1099div)

boxes.label: Unrecap. Sec. 1250 gain
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 2a. 'Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is unrecaptured section 1250 gain from certain depreciable real property. See the Unrecaptured Section 1250 Gain Worksheet in the Instructions for Schedule D (Form 1040).' Its destination is a Schedule D rate worksheet, which is outside this scope; it is never added to income.

boxes.label: Section 1202 gain
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 2a. 'Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is section 1202 gain from certain small business stock that may be subject to an exclusion. See the Schedule D (Form 1040) instructions.' Destination is the Schedule D QSB exclusion treatment, outside this scope.

boxes.label: Collectibles (28%) gain
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 2a. 'Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is 28% rate gain from sales or exchanges of collectibles. If required, use this amount when completing the 28% Rate Gain Worksheet in the Instructions for Schedule D (Form 1040).' Destination is a Schedule D rate worksheet, outside this scope.

boxes.label: Section 897 ordinary dividends
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1a - NOT of box 2a. 'Shows the portion of the amount in box 1a that is section 897 gain attributable to disposition of U.S. real property interests (USRPI).' Applies only to foreign persons and entities.

boxes.label: Section 897 capital gain
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 2a. 'Shows the portion of the amount in box 2a that is section 897 gain attributable to disposition of USRPI.' Applies only to foreign persons and entities.

boxes.label: Nondividend distributions
boxes.notes: A return of capital. It reduces basis and is not taxable until basis is recovered; the excess is then capital gain reported on Form 8949 (cross-scope).

boxes.label: Federal income tax withheld
boxes.notes: Backup withholding.

boxes.label: Section 199A dividends
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1a. 'Shows the portion of the amount in box 1a that may be eligible for the 20% qualified business income deduction under section 199A. See the instructions for Form 8995 and Form 8995-A.' Its destination is the QBI scope, outside this part.

boxes.label: Investment expenses
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 1a. 'Shows your share of expenses of a nonpublicly offered RIC, generally a nonpublicly offered mutual fund. This amount is included in box 1a.' The recipient instruction names no destination and no deduction; it routes nowhere.

boxes.label: Foreign tax paid
boxes.notes: 'Shows the foreign tax that you may be able to claim as a deduction or a credit on Form 1040 or 1040-SR.' A taxpayer election.

boxes.label: Foreign country or U.S. possession
boxes.notes: 'This box should be left blank if a RIC reported the foreign tax shown in box 7.' No route.

boxes.label: Cash liquidation distributions
boxes.notes: 'Show cash and noncash liquidation distributions.' The recipient instruction names NO destination. Treated as amounts received in exchange for the stock (see Pub. 550); the resulting gain or loss is a capital gains scope matter. No route is recorded here because the form states none.

boxes.label: Noncash liquidation distributions
boxes.notes: See box 9. The recipient instruction names no destination.

boxes.label: Exempt-interest dividends
boxes.notes: Federally tax-exempt dividends from a mutual fund or other RIC. Box 13 is inside this figure.

boxes.label: Specified private activity bond interest dividends
boxes.notes: COMPONENT OF BOX 12, but an AMT preference with its own destination. 'Shows exempt-interest dividends subject to the alternative minimum tax. This amount is included in box 12. See the Instructions for Form 6251.'

boxes.label: State
boxes.notes: State reporting. No federal route.

boxes.label: State identification no.
boxes.notes: State reporting. No federal route.

boxes.label: State tax withheld
boxes.notes: State reporting. No federal route.

boxes.label: CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed above the issuer's block on every copy. A corrected form replaces one furnished earlier; its figures are the ones to use, never counted beside the earlier form's.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. Printed on Copy A (the issuer's filing copy) and the state copy; the recipient's Copy B does not print it.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.notes: FR-016 mark. An account or other unique number the issuer assigned; identification only, never a figure.

boxes.label: FATCA filing requirement
boxes.notes: The FATCA filing requirement checkbox, printed as box 11. Named with its printed number so the FR-016 mark is declared; a reader's `Box11` still reaches the row keyed `11`.

document.notes: Continuous-use form; revision in force for TY2024 and TY2025 is Rev. January 2024, so https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/f1099div--2025.pdf does not exist. THREE nested groups live on this one form: box 1a contains 1b, 2e, 5 and 6; box 2a contains 2b, 2c, 2d and 2f; box 12 contains 13. The trap that catches readers is box 2e, whose '2' prefix suggests it sits inside box 2a - the printed instruction says box 1a.
